content.title: OXM Q3 Deep Dive: Tariff Pressures and Promotional Activity Drive Mixed Results
content.summary: Fashion conglomerate Oxford Industries (NYSE:OXM) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $307.3 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $375 million was less impressive, coming in 4.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.92 per share was 2.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
